value.message: Cartwheels Gym Centre runs Tiny Gym for ages 1 and walking to 3 with a parent, 45 minute classes, and registration opened July 22 at 8am online - their site says. Halton Hills Gymnastics Centre has Parent and Tot for 18 months to 3.11, Sept 12 to Dec 18, registration opened July 20. I couldn't get into their pages today to pin down days and prices, so I'll keep watching and text you when I do.
